query: What is the most expensive page of a comic book ever sold at auction?

results.title: Most expensive page of comic art sold at auction
results.content:
The most expensive page of comic art sold at auction is page 25 of Marvel Super-Heroes Secret Wars #8, which was sold for $3,360,000 (£2,458,880 / €2,948,010) by Heritage Auctions, on 13 January 2022.

The 1984 comic book was illustrated by Mike Zeck (USA). Page 25 tells the origin story of Spiderman's iconic black symbiote costume. Page 24 of the same comic was also sold as part of the action, fetching $288,000! [...] The sale greatly surpasses the previous record of $657,250 paid for a page of The Incredible Hulk (1974) which featured the rise of Wolverine. [...] en

Later in the auction, collectors were offered one of the most prized pieces from John Byrne and Terry Austin’s legendary X-Men run: an uncanny page from 1978’s X-Men No. 113, featuring the mutants trapped alongside Magneto. The artwork sold for $108,000. Another all-star piece — Michael Golden’s cover for 1981’s What If? No. 29, which asked “What If the Avengers Defeated Everybody?” — sold for $72,000. More expensive than a Disney+ subscription but more legendary, too.

results.title: Three Brothers Found a 1939 Copy of 'Superman No. 1' in Their Mother's Attic. It Just Became the Most Expensive Comic Book Ever Sold
results.content:
But when the brothers reached the attic, they found a stack of comic books in a box of old newspapers. And “rare” turned out to be an understatement. Their mother owned a near-pristine copy of Superman No. 1 from 1939—the first issue of the Man of Steel’s solo comic.

Now, the family has sold it for $9.12 million—making it the most expensive comic book ever auctioned. [...] According to an October statement from Heritage Auctions, the attic comic book collection included five early issues of Action Comics, the series published by National Allied Publications. Until this month, the record for the most expensive comic belonged to a 1938 copy of Action Comics No. 1, containing Superman’s debut. Heritage Auctions sold it in 2024 for $6 million. [...] The brothers, who’ve chosen to remain anonymous, contacted Heritage Auctions a few months after they found the comics. Lon Allen, vice president of the Dallas-based auction house, traveled to northern California to examine their discovery.

results.content: Time and again, new records were realized: Page 17 from the second issue of Claremont, Frank Miller and Joe Rubinstein's Wolverine mini-series realized $156,000, making it Miller's most valuable rendering of the man called Logan. Writer-artist Bob Layton's original cover art for Marvel Super Heroes Secret Wars No. 7 — starring Captain America, three of the X-Men, a "new" Spider-Woman and She-Hulk, among others — sold for $132,000, setting a new auction record for a work by the famed Iron Man [...] Speaking of, Page 4 from Tales of Suspense No. 39 by Don Heck — in which Tony Stark takes shrapnel to his heart — realized $132,000. And one of the earliest (and largest) X-Men covers ever offered at auction also saw plenty of action last week when the original front of The X-Men No. 26 realized $132,000.
